result.title: A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences
result.comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering Researches (ICECER 2026), December 3-5, 2026
result.summary: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation. Experiments on a test dataset show that the workflow produces more consistent, evidence-grounded and traceable diagnoses than the same LLM without structured workflow guidance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个受控 LLM 工作流：检索相似历史交易作为参照，结合对比式 SHAP 证据并做基于参照的 LLM 推理与确定性校验，用以解释风险评分差异；实验显示比无结构引导的同一 LLM 给出更一致、更有证据支撑且可溯源的诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索参照证据＋对比归因＋确定性校验」的结构化流程可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、证据落地与停止/校验决策提供方法线索，需核查该证据选择与验证机制在多模态推理中的可迁移性。
